notes: Fixed a song stopping a fraction of a second after you press play: if another app grabbed audio focus back at the very start, SideCut obeyed the loss and paused. That early loss is the hand-over itself, not an interruption — nothing has played yet — so the song now keeps going and SideCut takes focus back
A call still pauses your song and it still comes back when the call ends — that applies once the song is genuinely under way, not during the opening second

A pause command from the lock screen or the notification player that arrives before any audio has played is refused as well, so a stale media-button event cannot silence a song that has only just started

When SideCut takes audio back from another app it tells you once, and every playback stop (or refused stop) is recorded — 5 taps on the version label shows it on screen, so a stop that only happens on your phone can be read instead of guessed at
The audio-focus plugin can no longer take the app down with it: a focus callback that threw used to kill the app process mid-song
Includes the album and RGB fixes from 58.6 that were rolled back before they stuck
